utfall: vunne leveår for gruvearbeidere hvis en firedel av MSHAs håndhevingsbudsjett flyttes til andre helsetiltak; de fleste estimatene av MSHA-effekt er ikke signifikante
sitat: MSHA's targeted public health objective could be much better served (almost 700,000 life years gained on balance for miners) if a quarter of MSHA's enforcement budget were reallocated to other programs such as more heart disease screening or defibrillators at worksites.
